title: Spot detection
description: Detect smFISH spots with Big-FISH's LoG detector, automatic elbow threshold and Gaussian sub-pixel fit, and count them per cell.

detect-spots.title: Detect spots
detect-spots.description: Detect spots in one TIFF image or stack and write a spots CSV, a NIfTI spot overlay and, with cell labels, spots per cell.

image.description: One one-channel TIFF image or stack (uint8, uint16, float32 or float64).

labels.description: Optional integer cell labels: one y × x plane or a stack of the image's size.

voxelYx.description: Pixel size in y and x, nm.

radiusYx.description: Spot radius in y and x, nm.

threshold.description: LoG threshold; omit for Big-FISH's automatic elbow threshold.

projection.description: Detect in the 2D maximum projection of a stack.

subpixel.description: Fit each spot with a Gaussian for its sub-pixel position.
